sections.development: The approved riff from the first downbeat; the engine room joins from bar 3. Kick on the riff strokes, snare on 3.
Hook B (the answer) on bells in the riff rhythm augmented; the kick follows the bells; the scream gets stuck, the clock races; overload.
The breaker trips on the downbeat the build promised. Silence; the lament reaches D for the first time; the voice starts the answer and the bells echo it.
Warm coughs chop the held Bb; stroke by stroke hotter; bar 28 shifts gear into triplets.
The riff limping in triplets over a G pedal; bowed-metal chords i-bVI-iv-V then i-bVI-bII-V; Hook B sequenced through them; hand drums; a chopped vocal line.
The stair in slow motion: the bass alone, one gear tooth every 1.5 beats; the clock; one high cry.
Riff + Hook B; the voice sings the stair high, then climbs to C6; bowed metal climbs D-G chromatically; bell wedges in contrary motion; second blackout.
The whole song sung alone; the machine answers warm; Ab major -> G major.
